issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (Europe)

plan.diagnosis: Xenon Precision Supply S.p.A. presents a single-source sub-tier dependency risk with USD 2,441,061 in annual spend and 23 sub-tier suppliers, yet only a resiliency score of 62 and 2 disruption events in the past 12 months. The Italy-based supplier's sub-tier network lacks transparency and redundancy, exposing the organization to potential supply chain interruptions that have already materialized twice in the trailing period.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct immediate sub-tier mapping exercise with Xenon to identify the single-source critical sub-tier supplier(s) among the 23 and document their production dependencies, lead times, and geographic concentration
Issue RFI to 3-5 qualified alternate sub-tier suppliers in Europe and assess technical capability, capacity, and willingness to serve as secondary sources for the identified critical components

Negotiate contractual requirement with Xenon to dual-source the critical sub-tier material and establish minimum inventory buffer (30-45 days) to mitigate disruption risk, with quarterly sub-tier performance reporting
Qualify and onboard the alternate sub-tier supplier through Xenon's supply chain, including technical validation, quality audits, and trial production runs

Implement quarterly business reviews with Xenon including sub-tier health metrics, resiliency scoring, and disruption incident root cause analysis to drive continuous improvement above 75 resiliency threshold

plan.expected_impact: Reducing disruption frequency from 2 events per year to zero through sub-tier redundancy is expected to avoid USD 488,212 in annual disruption costs (20% of spend at risk based on historical event impact).
kpis: Sub-tier supplier diversity index (target: minimum 2 qualified sources for critical materials)
Xenon resiliency score improvement (target: increase from 62 to 75+ within 6 months)
Disruption event frequency (target: 0 events in next 12 months)
Sub-tier visibility coverage (target: 100% mapping of critical sub-tier suppliers)
Supply chain response time for sub-tier issues (target: <48 hours notification)
risks: Xenon may resist sub-tier transparency due to competitive concerns or lack of leverage with their own suppliers
Alternate sub-tier qualification timeline may extend beyond 12 weeks due to technical complexity or capacity constraints
Dual-sourcing may increase piece-part costs by 5-8% reducing savings from the USD 2,441,061 spend base
Geographic concentration in Europe leaves residual regional risk if alternate sub-tier is also EU-based
Integration complexity across 5 ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) may delay visibility and reporting rollout
erp_actions: SAP: Add sub-tier supplier transparency requirement flag in LFA1 vendor master and create custom field in LFB1 for resiliency score tracking with monthly updates
Coupa: Configure supplier risk profile for Xenon with automated alert threshold when resiliency score falls below 65 or disruption events exceed 1 per quarter
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for alternate sub-tier suppliers once qualified, with quota arrangement splitting 70/30 between primary and secondary
Oracle EBS/Dynamics 365/NetSuite: Establish purchase order approval workflow requiring Category Manager sign-off for any Xenon PO exceeding USD 50,000 until dual-sourcing is confirmed
Coupa: Implement contract clause library entry mandating sub-tier mapping disclosure and quarterly reporting for all suppliers with spend above USD 1,000,000
SAP: Set up vendor evaluation (ME61) with sub-tier resilience as weighted criterion (20%) for future Xenon performance scoring
